camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore CreateAccount --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --AccountName demoaccount --AccountPassword uWonno210000
description_en: Creates an account for an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 创建云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的账号
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore create-account --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --account-name demoaccount --account-password uWonno210000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en:
The account name. The name must meet the following requirements:
Starts with a lowercase letter and contains only lowercase letters, digits, or underscores (_).
Contains up to 100 characters.
Cannot be a <props="china">reserved word for Redis account names (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/redis/user-guide/create-and-manage-database-accounts#section-u3q-817-om3)</props><props="intl">reserved word for Redis account names (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/redis/user-guide/create-and-manage-database-accounts#section-u3q-817-om3)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
账号名，需满足以下条件：
以英文字母开头，由小写英文字母、数字或下划线（_）组成。
长度不超过100个字符。
不能为<props="china">Redis账号名保留字 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/redis/user-guide/create-and-manage-database-accounts#section-u3q-817-om3)</props><props="intl">Redis账号名保留字 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/redis/user-guide/create-and-manage-database-accounts#section-u3q-817-om3)</props>
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The permissions of the account. Valid values:
RoleReadOnly: read-only permissions.
RoleReadWrite: read and write permissions. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
账号权限，取值：
RoleReadOnly：只读权限。
RoleReadWrite：读写权限，默认值
parameters.name: account_privilege

parameters.help_en: The password of the account. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, special characters, and digits. The following special characters are supported: `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.help_zh: 账号的密码。长度为8~32位，需包含大写字母、小写字母、特殊字符和数字中的至少三种，允许的特殊字符包括`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The description of the account.
Must start with a Chinese character or an English letter. Cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
Can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). 
Must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
账号描述。
需以中文、英文字母开头，不能以`http: //`或`https: //`开头。
可以包含中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。 
长度为2~256个字符。
parameters.name: account_description

parameters.help_en: The account type. Set the value to Normal (standard account)
parameters.help_zh: 账号类型，取值固定为Normal（普通账号）
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 本参数仅用于内部维护，无需传入
parameters.name: source_biz

parameters.help_en:
The account parameters to modify in JSON format. The new values overwrite the original values.
<notice>This parameter is supported only for Tair Serverless KV instances.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
需修改的账号参数，格式为 JSON，修改后的值会覆盖原来的值。
<notice>该参数目前仅支持Tair Serverless KV实例。></notice>
parameters.name: parameters
